lines.text: Hold on. This video was 39 clips on my phone.
No editing app touched this, but let's rewind, see what touched it.
First, AI listened very carefully to every word I said. It got the start time, it got the end time.
It even got my name wrong. Instead of Vish, it got Rish. But one line fixed it.
Then it cut everything, not in between the sentences, but in between the words.
Then it cut me out, every single frame, and the caption sits behind me.
Every caption, every sticker is a tiny web page, photographed 30 times a second.

lines.clone: Let's slow down time. At one frame a second, a one-minute reel takes thirty minutes to watch.
And the sound? Silence. Exactly where it hurts.

lines.text: And it didn't take 1, it didn't take 5, it took 12 rounds of feedback from me to get the perfect video I want. Hi, I'm Vish.
And if you're still here, the edit did its job. Comment EDIT, and I will send you the prompts.
